notes: The engine loads each collection, resolves the highest-weight non-rejected version per entry, and freezes that view for the Dimension session.
Changes mid-session do not retroactively apply; a Dimension inherits the rules snapshot of the session it was opened under (recorded in ActiveDimensions/<id>/rules_snapshot_commit).
contradictions.json holds the FIRST governance proposals (status proposal) plus resolved history (status resolved, weight 0).

governance.json, sync_protocol.json, hashgraph_events.json and dimension_session.json are the machine-readable form of the P2P / Radicle / hashgraph game idea; concept.json keeps only the narrative summary.
Entry counts in `collections` are informational; the editor and engine must trust the files, not these numbers.

Every active version carries a  block (JsonLogic). Named rules live once in logic_rules.json; game/logic-engine.mjs evaluates them; tools/logic-check.mjs and tools/rebalance.mjs validate data and proposals. Authoring guide: game/tools/logic/README.md.

examples.ActiveDimensions: examples/ActiveDimensions/<DimensionName>/ - a filled-in dimension.json + doors/<DoorId>.json pair following dimension_session.json shapes
